title: Home Ahead demo
note: Played by the simulator at /?demo=1 and by video/record.ts. 'speak' overrides how a line is read aloud by the TTS voice.

steps.text: Babyproofing is usually a one-time job. But every time a baby learns a new move, the risks in a home change. Home Ahead keeps the home one step ahead.
My sister is giving us her old high chair and crib.

steps.speak: It says T B, H C, six nine zero zero.

steps.text: Model CR-2208, and yes, it has bumpers.
steps.speak: Model C R, twenty-two oh eight. And yes, it has bumpers.

steps.text: She pulled herself up on the couch today!
Put anchoring the dresser on the calendar for Saturday morning.
We anchored the dresser and the TV.
I emailed them for the repair kit.
Are we ready for the next stage?

Under the hood: a self-hosted MCP server on the 2025-11-25 spec, nine intent-level tools, MCP Apps cards, and real recall notices from the U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission. It all runs locally with npm start.
